phrase.zh: 热，使表面有了新的出口。
phrase.en: Heat opens a way beyond the surface.

visual.zh: 横向钢套在右侧露出椭圆开口，剖视内部的连续热丝在回弯处呈暗红色，细点散向浅色留白。黑白版保留同一剖视关系，以浅灰热丝对照暗色内腔；这不是实验装置复原。
visual.en: A horizontal steel sleeve opens into an ellipse at the right. A cutaway reveals a continuous filament with a muted red return bend; sparse dots spread into the pale space beyond. The neutral edition keeps the same cutaway, with a pale gray filament against the dark interior. This is not a reconstructed apparatus.

background.zh:
理查森获1928年诺贝尔物理学奖，实际于1929年领受。他研究金属受热时释放电子的现象，并发现描述这一现象的规律。钢套、热丝与细点是受热释放的原创寓意，不是历史仪器、实验数据或科学示意图；短句为原创。
1928年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他研究热电子现象，并发现以其名字命名的规律。
background.en:
Richardson was awarded the 1928 Nobel Prize in Physics and received it in 1929. He studied the release of electrons from heated metal and discovered a law describing this behavior. The sleeve, filament and dots are an original metaphor for release through heating, not a historical instrument, experimental data or a scientific schematic. The phrase is original.
1928 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his work on the thermionic phenomenon and especially for the discovery of the law named after him

labelLocalized.en: 1928 The Nobel Prize in Physics — official record
